how_to_apply: Applications are sent by email. The notice states that the completed application must be received by 4:00 PM on 2 December 2026.
Get the prescribed application format (Annexure-I, "Lady Medical Officer – Application Format") from the Andaman & Nicobar Administration website or the ANIIMS website.

Fill in the form in capital letters only. A recent photograph goes on the form.
Complete the checklist and the declaration, then sign it with date and place.
Email the application with soft copies of the relevant documents to [email protected].

For queries, the notice gives the contact number 03192-24177, available from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM on all days except holidays, and from 10:00 AM to 01:00 PM on Saturdays.
important_instructions: The interview date will be intimated later. The schedule is tentative and subject to change, depending on the availability of the Selection Committee. Changes will be updated on the ANIIMS website. The Director, ANIIMS reserves the right to reschedule the dates and time at any stage of the interview. The Director reserves the right to increase, decrease or cancel the notified vacancy at any stage of the interview or selection procedure. The declaration on the form says that any discrepancy found will disqualify the candidature even after selection.

content_sections.heading: About ANIIMS
content_sections.text: ANIIMS is the Andaman & Nicobar Islands Institute of Medical Sciences at Sri Vijaya Puram. The notice is issued by the Office of the Director of ANIIMS, under the Andaman & Nicobar Administration. The post is advertised on a contract basis.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice does not print any experience requirement for the post. The application format has a column for experience, if any, and for the State Medical Council registration number. Candidates should check the official notification for any further eligibility detail.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement is on contract basis for one year. All the posts are purely temporary. The candidate has no right to claim a regular appointment. The notice mentions no allowances beyond the consolidated pay.

rows.pay: Consolidated monthly pay of Rs.86,000/- per month

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ANIIMS Lady Medical Officer
content_sections.text: Applications are sent by email. The notice states that the completed application must be received by 4:00 PM on 2 December 2026. Get the prescribed application format (Annexure-I, "Lady Medical Officer – Application Format") from the Andaman & Nicobar Administration website or the ANIIMS website. Fill in the form in capital letters only. It asks for personal details, date of birth and age, academic qualification, correspondence and permanent address, current job details, awards and achievements if any, and MBBS marks for the 1st to 4th Prof with State Medical Council registration number. A recent photograph goes on the form. Complete the checklist and the declaration, then sign it with date and place. Email the application with soft copies of the relevant documents to [email protected] . Wait for the interview date, which will be intimated later. Details and changes will be put on the ANIIMS website. For queries, the notice gives the contact number 03192-24177, available from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM on all days except holidays, and from 10:00 AM to 01:00 PM on Saturdays.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: The application checklist in Annexure-I lists these documents. Candidates appearing for the interview must have the documents mentioned in the notice in original at the time of interview. 10th pass certificate Attempt and Character Certificate Mark sheets of all the professional years MBBS certificate/Degree Internship Completion Certificate MBBS State Medical Council/MCI registration certificate Pan Card Aadhaar Card Experience, if any All supporting documents

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The interview date will be intimated later. The schedule is tentative and subject to change, depending on the availability of the Selection Committee. Changes will be updated on the ANIIMS website. The Director, ANIIMS reserves the right to reschedule the dates and time at any stage of the interview. The Director reserves the right to increase, decrease or cancel the notified vacancy at any stage of the interview or selection procedure. The declaration on the form says that any discrepancy found will disqualify the candidature even after selection.

faq.question: Q1. How many Lady Medical Officer posts has ANIIMS announced?
faq.answer: ANIIMS has announced one (01) vacant position of Lady Medical Officer. The Director reserves the right to increase, decrease or cancel the vacancy at any stage.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for ANIIMS Lady Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The completed application must be received by 4:00 PM on 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ANIIMS Lady Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is MBBS (As per NMC Norms).

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the ANIIMS Lady Medical Officer?
faq.answer: The consolidated monthly pay is Rs.86,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for ANIIMS Lady Medical Officer?
faq.answer: Send the application in the prescribed format, with soft copies of the relevant documents, by email to [email protected]. The format is available on the Andaman & Nicobar Administration and ANIIMS websites.

faq.question: Q6. When is the ANIIMS Lady Medical Officer interview?
faq.answer: The date of interview will be intimated later, and changes will be updated on the ANIIMS website.

faq.question: Q7. Is the ANIIMS Lady Medical Officer job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is on contract basis for one year, and all the posts are purely temporary. The candidate has no right to claim a regular appointment.

faq.question: Q8. Which documents should I bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates appearing for the interview must have the documents mentioned in the notice in original. The Annexure-I checklist lists them, including the MBBS certificate, the registration certificate, the Pan Card and the Aadhaar Card.

faq.answer: The notice gives 03192-24177, available from 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM on all days except holidays, and from 10:00 AM to 01:00 PM on Saturdays.
